sources.title: GitHub - AlibabaCloud-Official/Qwen3.8-27B: Native multimodal dense LLM ...
sources.snippet: Welcome to the repository for Qwen3.8-27B —the latest native multimodal dense open-weight model released by Alibaba's Qwen team. Delivering top-tier performance for local hardware, Qwen3.8-27B excels at coding, agentic workflows, and office automation tasks.

sources.title: RadixArk/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The RadixArk Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 model is the quantized version of Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B. The quantization was produced at RadixArk using NVIDIA Model Optimizer, following a mixed NVFP4 W4A4 recipe.

sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.8-27B is the 27-billion-parameter dense member of the Qwen3.8 family, on the same hybrid-attention backbone as the 2.4T MoE flagship. The layer mix is the interesting part. Only 16 of the 64 layers run full attention (full_attention_interval: 4); the other 48 run linear attention with a constant recurrent state.
